strategy: Start with a Lunatic setup until level 32, then respec into the Apocalypse build with Umbral Chains to ramp stacks for massive AoE bursts. Upgrade your weapon and apply useful Occultist Aspects early, then progress through War Plans activities after the campaign for consistent experience gain.

paragon.note: Occultist is strong here since almost all skills are Occult skills. Level glyphs as high as comfortable in speedruns. Maxroll shows this build's Paragon board pathing through an interactive planner (D4Planner) rather than as plain text, so the exact board order can't be faithfully scraped - check source_url for the visual layout.
